en: Black‑and‑white view of a European small town dominated by a large hilltop castle complex with a tall, tiered Baroque tower rising above multi‑winged stone buildings and steep tiled roofs. Below the castle are several modest houses, tree‑lined streets, and a riverbank road curving to the right. Forested hills surround the settlement. On the gable of a large building in the right foreground there are several painted advertisement panels in German.
